init.title: Configure model profile
init.description: Create a reusable provider model profile. Conversation agents and AI tasks select one primary profile and optional fallbacks.

data_description.model: Model name as understood by the configured OpenAI-compatible provider.
data_description.temperature: Controls response randomness. Leave empty to use the provider or model default.
data_description.thinking: Optional reasoning effort or boolean thinking control. Provider and model support varies.
data_description.configure_advanced_model_settings: Open a second step for token limits, sampling, timeout, tool-call behavior, seed, penalties, and JSON overrides.

model_settings.title: Advanced model settings
model_settings.description: Set optional Pydantic AI ModelSettings values for this model profile. Leave fields empty to use provider defaults.

data_description.max_tokens: Maximum tokens the model may generate. Must be a positive integer.
data_description.top_p: Nucleus sampling value. Leave empty to use the provider default.
data_description.timeout: Request timeout in seconds. Must be positive. If empty, validation uses the integration default timeout.
data_description.parallel_tool_calls: Allow the model/provider to make tool calls in parallel when supported.
data_description.seed: Optional non-negative integer seed for providers that support deterministic sampling.
data_description.presence_penalty: Penalty for introducing tokens already present in the conversation. Provider support and ranges vary.
data_description.frequency_penalty: Penalty based on token frequency in the conversation. Provider support and ranges vary.
data_description.extra_headers: JSON object of string headers to send with model requests. Values are redacted in diagnostics.
data_description.extra_body: JSON object merged into provider request bodies for provider-specific options. Values are redacted in diagnostics.

error.invalid_headers: Enter a JSON object with string keys and string values.
error.invalid_integer: Enter an integer value in this field.
error.invalid_number: Enter a valid number in this field.
error.invalid_object: Enter a JSON object, not an array or scalar value.
error.positive_number: Enter a number greater than zero.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating the provider. Check Home Assistant logs for details.

init.title: Configure AI task
init.description: Choose the model profile for Home Assistant AI task data generation. Structured output defaults to tool output.

data_description.mcp_server_ids: Optional MCP servers this AI task model may use. Runtime use requires the MCP server to have an explicit allowed-tools list.
data_description.web_fetch_enabled: Allow this AI task model to fetch web page content from URLs. WebFetch is disabled by default and does not require MCP.
data_description.skills: Optional local skills this AI task may load from the provider skills folder.
data_description.fallback_model_subentry_ids: Optional ordered fallback profiles to try when the primary model has a retryable provider or usage-limit failure.
data_description.configure_output_mode: Open a second step to choose how Pydantic AI asks the model for structured data.

output_mode.title: Advanced structured output
output_mode.description: Choose the Pydantic AI structured output mode for this AI task model.

data_description.output_mode: Tool output is the default and works with providers that support tool calls. Native uses the provider's JSON schema support. Prompted asks for JSON in the prompt and validates the result.

init.title: Configure Assist agent
init.description: Choose the model profile and Home Assistant tool access for this Assist agent.

data_description.prompt: Instruct how the LLM should respond. This can be a template.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Select which tools the model can use to interact with your devices and entities.
data_description.mcp_server_ids: Optional MCP servers this Assist agent may use. Runtime use requires the MCP server to have an explicit allowed-tools list.
data_description.web_fetch_enabled: Allow this Assist agent to fetch web page content from URLs. WebFetch is disabled by default and does not require MCP.
data_description.skills: Optional local skills this Assist agent may load from the provider skills folder.
data_description.fallback_model_subentry_ids: Optional ordered fallback profiles to try when the primary model has a retryable provider or usage-limit failure.

model_settings.title: Advanced model settings
model_settings.description: Set optional Pydantic AI ModelSettings values for this Assist agent. Leave fields empty to use provider defaults.

data_description.max_tokens: Maximum tokens the model may generate. Must be a positive integer.
data_description.top_p: Nucleus sampling value. Leave empty to use the provider default.
data_description.timeout: Request timeout in seconds. Must be positive. If empty, validation uses the integration default timeout.
data_description.parallel_tool_calls: Allow the model/provider to make tool calls in parallel when supported.
data_description.seed: Optional non-negative integer seed for providers that support deterministic sampling.
data_description.presence_penalty: Penalty for introducing tokens already present in the conversation. Provider support and ranges vary.
data_description.frequency_penalty: Penalty based on token frequency in the conversation. Provider support and ranges vary.
data_description.extra_headers: JSON object of string headers to send with model requests. These values are stored in Home Assistant config entry storage; do not use this for API secrets.
data_description.extra_body: JSON object merged into provider request bodies for provider-specific options.

init.title: Configure MCP server
init.description: Add a remote Streamable HTTP MCP server. Tools are discovered before saving. Stdio/local command servers are not supported by this integration.

data_description.mcp_url: HTTP or HTTPS URL for the remote Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Local, LAN, mDNS, and public hosts are supported. HTTPS is recommended when using headers or sensitive tool data.
data_description.mcp_headers: Optional HTTP headers, one per line, using 'Header-Name: value'. Values are redacted in diagnostics.
